Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
From metabolism
Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id
Join compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary as substrate on compound_records.molregno = substrate.molregno
Left Join molecule_hierarchy on substrate.molregno = molecule_hierarchy.molregno and molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno is not null
Left Join molecule_dictionary as parent on molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
Left Join target_dictionary on metabolism.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'
Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
Limit 200
